description: Source code for command line argument parsing and handling in a POSIX environment within Zephyr OS, including functions for adding options, handling command line args, and cleanup.

methods.name: native_cleanup_cmd_line
methods.description: Frees allocated command line argument structures.

methods.name: native_add_command_line_opts
methods.description: Adds command line options to the internal options list.

methods.name: native_add_testargs_option
methods.description: Adds a test argument option to the command line options.

methods.name: print_invalid_opt_error
methods.description: Prints an error message for invalid command line options and exits.

methods.name: native_handle_cmd_line
methods.description: Processes command line arguments, sets defaults, and handles test args.

methods.name: native_get_cmd_line_args
methods.description: Provides access to the original command line arguments.

methods.name: native_get_test_cmd_line_args
methods.description: Provides access to command line arguments after --testargs.
